field.name: runnerNote
field.purpose: optional member of QueuedTurnRunner: the worker asks the chat host to say one line in the message's chat when it gives up writing a message's outcome after BUSY_GIVE_UP_MS (60 s), asking the user to reload the window

rationale: S004 bounded the busy outcome write at 60 s; the worker owns the store but only the chat host can speak in the chat. Additive and optional. Built and approved in S004.
